title: No Es (15s micro-cut)
voice_notes: Remix variant — reuses lesson-04-no-es audio via explicit segment keys. No new TTS.

segments.say: Es normal means it is normal.
To make it negative, Spanish does one thing. It puts no in front.
What about: it is not legal?
You just park no in front. That is the whole move.

caption: Negative sentences in Spanish: park no in front. Es legal → no es legal. The whole move.
